admin.updateConfirmTitle: Install a version you cannot simply go back from?
admin.updateConfirmBody: This version changes the database in a way the version running now cannot read, so it cannot be undone by going back to it. Enan takes a backup first; returning to it later means restoring that backup and losing what was written since.
admin.updateAutomaticHelp: Off, new versions are announced here and wait for Install now. On, each one is installed when it is out, after a backup. A version you cannot go back from always waits for you.
admin.updateWindowHelp: Leave both empty to install at any time. New versions are still checked for all day.
